name: ZHD-TALLY PAYMENT ENTRY
report_script:
import frappe

def execute(filters=None):
    columns = [
        {"label": "Voucher No", "fieldname": "voucher_no", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 180},
        {"label": "Date", "fieldname": "date", "fieldtype": "Date", "width": 100},
        {"label": "Ledger", "fieldname": "ledger", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 150},
        {"label": "Amount", "fieldname": "amount", "fieldtype": "Currency", "width": 120},
        {"label": "Bank Account No", "fieldname": "bank_account_no", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 160},
        {"label": "IFSC Code", "fieldname": "ifsc_code", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 120},
        {"label": "Bank Name", "fieldname": "bank_name", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 150},
    ]

    data = frappe.db.sql("""
        SELECT
            ss.name AS voucher_no,
            ss.posting_date AS date,
            ss.employee_name AS ledger,
            ss.net_pay AS amount,
            e.bank_ac_no AS bank_account_no,
            e.ifsc_code AS ifsc_code,
            e.bank_name AS bank_name
        FROM `tabSalary Slip` ss
        INNER JOIN `tabEmployee` e
            ON e.name = ss.employee
        WHERE ss.docstatus = 1
        ORDER BY ss.posting_date
    """, as_dict=True)

    return columns, data
``
